newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine firms plan to buy 28,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine firms plan to buy 28,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Two Philippine flour mills plan to buy 28,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for November delivery, traders said on Friday.

"One firm invited us to give price quotes for 7,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content, 2,000 (tonnes) dark northern spring wheat with a 13.5 percent protein content and 3,000 tonnes western white wheat," said one trader at an American commodity house.
The Philippine flour mill will open the bids on Monday, the trader said.
Another trader in a Japanese commodity house said he received inquiries for 16,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
Philippine flour mills bought a total of 81,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat since October 4, traders said.
